title: New Hurricane Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Rare Variety
description:
Bring a burst of fiery colour to your garden with 'New Hurricane' Coleus!


KEY FEATURES
• Stunning fiery red and yellow foliage, intricately cut
• Versatile for containers, borders, or indoor display
• Low maintenance and deer resistant
• Thrives in full sun to partial shade
• Excellent for adding vibrant colour and texture


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Plectranthus scutellarioides 'New Hurricane'
Colour: Fiery Red and Yellow foliage, White flowers
Season: Spring, Summer (foliage interest)
Growth Habit: Bushy, upright


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full Sun to Partial Shade
Soil: Moist, well-drained, fertile soil (loamy with compost)
Watering: Water regularly, about an inch per week. Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged. Container plants may need daily watering in hot, dry weather.
Spacing: 12-18 inches (30-45 cm)
Height: 1-3 feet (30-90 cm)
Spread: 1-3 feet (30-90 cm)
Hardiness: USDA Zone 11 (Tender Annual in UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in well-draining soil and water thoroughly upon planting, keeping root balls moist for the first 7-10 days.
• Pinch back young plants regularly to encourage bushiness and denser foliage.
• Remove flowering stalks to direct energy into foliage growth and maintain plant vigour.
• Protect from frost; 'New Hurricane' is cold-sensitive and will not survive freezing temperatures.
• For indoor plants, maintain 50-70% humidity and watch for common indoor pests like aphids or mealybugs.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant
